seo.title: Md Sumon Howlader | Durbin Films and Durbin News
seo.description: Md Sumon Howlader founded Durbin Films in 2022 and is the Editor and Publisher of Durbin News, the PID registered portal. A Dhaka producer building for a Bengali audience online since 2014.

name: Md Sumon Howlader
intro: Producer working online full time since 2014. He founded Durbin Films in July 2022 and runs it from Dhaka, Bangladesh, producing television dramas, web series, short films, documentaries, and brand work.

profile.heading: Ten years of one audience
paragraphs: Md Sumon Howlader has worked online full time since 2014, years before a Bengali audience arrived on YouTube and Facebook in the numbers it has today. More than two thousand projects have passed through his hands since then, most of them short films and documentaries. That volume taught him what no one can teach a producer: what people stop for, and what they scroll past.

He founded Durbin Films on 1 July 2022. The studio now runs its own YouTube channels with more than two and a half million subscribers between them, producing television dramas, web series, short films, documentaries, and brand work. Its drama has aired on television as well as online. He produces across the full slate, from choosing the story and setting the budget to final delivery.

Earlier that year, in February 2022, he launched Durbin News, registered by the Press Information Department as an online news portal in July 2022. He is its Editor and Publisher. Its main Facebook page reaches around 7.6 million followers and more than 500 million views a month, making it one of the most followed news outlets in Bangladesh.
